training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Same 25% color quartets, 25% navigation, 40% state calibration, 10% retained primitive schedule. State calibration uses one same-image quartet [v,-v,0,v/2] per microbatch; domains 25/25/50% and tasks 2..6 cycle. Common flow noise/time across the quartet; t=1 on even steps, sampled common time on odd steps. Other sampling unchanged.
training.loss: Flow matching on six normalized action channels, weights [8,8,1,4,1,1], divided by their sum. Runtime units and normalization unchanged.
training.data: Same dataset13 images, states, tasks and sampling. Relabel stationary xy and navigation xy/yaw only.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.
training.image_domains: Explicit per-image domains; new views are appended after the 6408 existing image IDs.
training.noise_schedule: For step=1..8000 and micro=0..1, frozen runtime Gaussian if (step+micro)%4<2, otherwise random. Same50/50 and common-noise/time quartet rules as13.
training.rationale: Stationary teacher imitation is already close but physical hover can fail. Increase the training-only braking coefficient modestly1.2->1.6. Forecast target bearing1s ahead for navigation yaw, using current own linear/angular velocity. Runtime remains unchanged.
training.recovery_storage: Unique recovery_stepNNNNN.pt plus SHA receipt every2000steps; no replacement or deletion of previous saves.

teacher.scope: Training labels only; frozen velocity-to-attitude controller already subtracts current estimated velocity.
teacher.nonhorizontal_labels: Vertical and takeoff/landing requests remain byte-identical. All landing targets and primitive yaw remain byte-identical. Navigation yaw uses1s bearing prediction.
teacher.reason: Train13 full9/16: initialhover2 failures despite small imitation error; requested-goal hold3 failures with lateral/yaw errors; one late-power failure after reacquisitions and one landing-clearance failure. These changes are hypotheses and do not uniquely isolate causality.
teacher.stationary_horizontal_command: -1.6 * input estimated horizontal velocity; norm cap0.2m/s, constant32steps. Zero unarmed or takeoff below0.25m.
teacher.yaw_target_rule: For armed rotation above0.8m: initial predicted yaw=own_yaw+1.0*own_yaw_rate. Iterate32 times at0.1s; rate=0 inside0.03rad else clip(0.8*(target-predicted_yaw), +/-0.25).
teacher.navigation_yaw_rule: At each teacher step, predict position=p+R(heading)*own_xy_velocity*1s and heading=heading-own_clockwise_rate*1s. Apply the existing0.8 proportional yaw law,0.05rad deadband,0.25rad/s cap to predicted requested-person bearing. Body velocity and heading rollout remain consistent.
teacher.navigation_world_goal: Same teacher goal: person position + [-1.0m,0] in the room plane. Scoring goal remains [-0.9m,0].

data.unchanged: All image/state/task input arrays, English prompts, sampling pools, flow-time/noise schedule, loss weights, vertical/request labels, primitive yaw, landing labels, runtime and scoring.

evaluation: Unchanged: dev 8/8; exposed stress >=14/16, >=7/8 each color, >=3/4 each layout; regression 5/5; known failure 1/1; then fresh matched 16 per model and preregistered static probe.
hypotheses_not_results: One-second bearing prediction may reduce delayed yaw oscillation and reacquisition. No runtime state or truth channel is added.
Moderate teacher braking1.6 may reduce steady drift; delayed feedback can also oscillate. All original stability and clearance gates still apply.
No evaluation images/states enter training. Fresh round02 remains unexposed.
Additional steps, new seed, and two label changes prevent an isolated causal attribution. Preserve and report every candidate and failure.
Offline one-step inference did not provide a consistent advantage; deployed inference remains10steps.
